description.value: Strathcona Community Centre is a City of Vancouver recreation facility serving one of the city's oldest and most historically significant neighbourhoods, located near the intersection of Keefer Street and Gore Avenue in the Strathcona district. As a publicly operated community centre, it offers recreational programming to residents and visitors in a neighbourhood that sits along several popular urban cycling routes connecting downtown Vancouver to East Van.
